profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Lowe's Companies, Inc.
profile.summary:
Versatile engineer offering extensive experience in software design, development, and delivery. Demonstrable and proven skills to quickly learn and apply new technologies, collaborate effectively across organizations and deliver results that exceed customer expectations. Curious critical thinker, adept at problem solving, producing creative solutions to complex issues and challenges. Customer focused, highly skilled at discerning requirements then converting to prioritized user stories and tasks. Expert at developing reliable, high-performing software that seamlessly evolves through changing features. Strong commitment to business value, driven thru process improvements and product quality.

Architecture | Microservices | Design & Development
Technology Integration | Performance Enhancements | Requirements Analysis
Root Cause Analysis | Test Automation | Productivity Enhancements 

TECHNICAL SKILLS
Languages: Java, Groovy, C / C++
Methodologies: Agile Development, Behavior and Test-Driven Development (BDD, TDD), Continuous Integration (CI), Software Deployment, OO Analysis & Design
Technologies: Micronaut, Project Reactor, HTTP/REST APIs, NoSQL Databases (MongoDB, Actian FastObjects), Kafka, JMS, Concurrency, Java FX, Java Swing, Spock, JUnit, JMock
Tools: IntelliJ, Git, BitBucket, JIRA, Confluence, Sonar, PlantUML

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Key member of team developing microservices for Lowe’s modernized Reverse Logistics solution.  The Java-based microservices are built using the Micronaut framework and integrate with MondoDB, DB2, Kafka, and external client APIs to provide Frontend responses, as well as perform numerous background business data processing tasks.
• Delivered robust and efficient microservices that average <0.5 sec response times, far exceeding our SLA of <1 sec, and have minimum defect occurrences.
• Worked with cross-functional team to understand business requirements, and show technical options.
• Led design and implementation of database classes, interaction using MongoDB aggregation framework and indexing strategy.
• Designed and implemented retry logic for external client API calls with circuit breaker capability to provide system resilience and stability when such clients fail, while ensuring all data is transmitted successfully. 
• Designed a solution for feature rollouts that allows turn-on and feature detail changes at a given time, reducing the need for coordinated deployments with dependent applications.
• Developed a framework for business process tasks that eliminates code duplicated in each task resulting in 25%+ faster development time since the effort spent is only on the core job of the task.
• Led and mentored the team in practices to achieve thorough testing and increased coverage through BDD using Spock data tables, TestContainers and WireMock. This allows implementation changes with almost no test changes.  Coverage is consistently around 90%.
• Provided documentation and diagrams for various components I’ve designed that show how the component works and give developers implementation direction.  Gave PlantUML training workshop.
• Served as mentor to 4 interns so far.  Provided guidance to them, and the team, on development best practices, coding styles for quality and performance, and problem solving.  The topics were received well and put into practice.

positions.title: Product Architect, Sabre Qik Solution
positions.description:
Set technical direction and collaborated with cross-functional team of 6-12 professionals in 3 countries on proprietary scripting product, Qik Solution - a Java-based development platform with custom IDE, runtime engine, and debugger that enables clients to create graphical and robotic applications unique to end-user environments.

• Led design and development of product enhancements:
  o Re-designed product core, transforming Qik apps from monolithic to modular apps with import ability and multi-threaded script execution capability.  
  o Provided new APIs for evolving technology, including XML, JMS, HTTP/REST, SOAP, and JSON.
  o Modernized IDE, adding productivity features such as parameter hints and code completion.  
  o Added command-line feature, allowing customers to build Qik apps in CI/CD environment.
  o Conceived and wrote QikUnit, significantly transforming ability to unit test Qik code.
• Partnered with clients in highly-collaborative design sessions, driving solutions for specific UX and technology needs.
• Collaborated with product owner to define release plans; planned and prioritized technical stories resulting in 98% early release delivery.
• Spearheaded testing growth, achieving 300+% rise in functional tests and code coverage increase from 48% to 80%.
• Increased team productivity through automation, reducing regression test time 50% and creating 5+ integration point simulators.
• Envisioned and developed automation tool achieving 50% reduction in time to add new language APIs.
• Conducted 15+ technical sales support presentations, 20+ advanced customer training sessions at conferences, webinars, and on-site workshops, and 50+ brown bag and training sessions to Java developers.
• Enhanced technical documentation quality, leading to 20% increase in customer satisfaction.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer, Front-End Developer, AirFlite
positions.description:
Joined team by request to provide technical leadership and mentor developers in Java Swing development and testing best practices. Partnered with customer liaison and user interaction team to establish design and requirements. 
• Updated existing UI with company-wide user experience (UX) standards, improving client satisfaction by providing cohesive look and feel throughout product portfolio.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer, Full Stack Developer, Qik Solution
positions.description:
Designed and developed enhancements to product in collaboration with team of 4-8 technical professionals.
• Championed and led adoption of test-driven development (TDD), increasing unit test coverage over 10%.
• Created ability in custom IDE to plug-in and configure any JavaBean component to hook into built-in capabilities.
• Collaborated on various Runtime technology enhancements, including Web Services, and peripheral device communication.
• Increased development efficiency by creating 10+ testing utilities, tool enhancements and build script updates.
